data.name: Concordia
data.gender_notes: Concordia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word concordia, meaning harmony, agreement, or union. In Christian tradition, Concordia can refer to a state of peace or unity, often associated with the virtues of kindness and understanding. The name Concordia carries the meaning “Harmony, agreement” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Concordia usually hope their child will grow to embody harmony, agreement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of unity and harmony in the Christian community and in personal relationships.
data.etymology: Concordia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Harmony, agreement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Concordia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Concordia" has been used historically in various contexts, including the name of educational institutions and cities. One such famous example is Concordia University in Montreal, Canada. This name reflects the values of cooperation, trust, and peace that these institutions aim to instill in their students.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Concordia holds a deeper spiritual significance. It represents the unity and harmony that exists among God, Jesus, and believers. In 1 Corinthians 1:10 (NIV), it reads, "I appeal to you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another in what you say and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly united in mind and thought." In daily life, living in Concordia implies striving for peace, harmony, and unity among people and in oneself.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Concordia represents harmony and agreement in Christian faith, symbolizing unity among believers, and the peaceful coexistence of God's will with human desires.
